sentence: This project builds imaging tools that show the structure of chromatin in cancer stem cells and how it relates to gene expression.
This project studies how gene expression systems in gut bacteria let them use complex carbohydrates as an energy source for growth.
This project gets an instrument that uses light on a metal surface to detect small molecules binding to protein targets.
This project builds and tests artificial intelligence methods made for children to detect when cancer has spread to the lungs.
This project tests whether a dendritic cell vaccine given with chemotherapy can prevent pancreatic cancer from returning, using imaging of labeled vaccine cells.
This project develops a delivery vehicle inspired by exosomes that carries CRISPR into blood stem cells for gene editing in sickle cell disease.
This project tests whether clinical lab data can predict which patients with head and neck cancer will benefit from immunotherapy.
This project designs peptides that push the HIV Gag polyprotein to assemble incorrectly, forming aberrant viral structures.
This project builds a computational tool that uses sequencing data to predict T cell rejection risk in solid organ transplants.
This project develops an AI-guided approach to manufacture photoreceptor cells for cell therapy in people with blindness.
This project spreads circuit analysis tools, including optogenetic methods, hydrogel-tissue chemistry and fiber photometry, for use in drug abuse research.
This project tests an enhanced hammerhead ribozyme RNA therapy for rescuing retinal degeneration in a mouse model of retinitis pigmentosa.
This project builds a workflow to find copy number variants in blended genome exome sequencing data from neuropsychiatric disorders.
This project uses genomic and imaging-based screening to find genes that promote efferocytosis in macrophages in atherosclerosis.
This project studies how a neural population in the brain senses changes in blood glucose and regulates glucagon and insulin secretion.
This project develops a brain imaging technology that uses proton magnetic resonance spectroscopic signals on clinical MRI scanners to measure molecules and tissue properties.
This project builds human cortical organoids to model the brain effects of myotonic dystrophy, including repeat-expansion RNA toxicity and tau mis-splicing.
This project organizes a consortium of craniofacial centers that study craniosynostosis syndromes, including regulatory compliance and data sharing.
This project supports state laboratories that test human and animal food for foodborne hazards and help with outbreak investigations.
This project tests whether oxytocin can treat migraine with aura, using a mouse model to measure pain and attack frequency.
